Which booking site listed the lowest prices for San Antonio hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 10 of the 15 San Antonio hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, Vio.com at 2, Billabook.com at 1, Evendo at 1, KAYAK.com at 1 and Pilot at 1. These are the San Antonio rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at San Antonio hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($24 a night) to the before-tax going rate. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
